message.content: No, Hailey did not mention the new high-protein breads to Li Hua prior to inviting him to the special bakery event. The new line of gluten-free breads was announced to Li Hua on March 23rd, stating that it would be available starting the following week. However, the new high-protein breads were not discussed until the special event was mentioned on June 22nd. During the event announcement, Hailey invited Li Hua to participate in a tasting session for the new healthy bread options, which included the high-protein breads. This indicates that the new high-protein breads were introduced separately and not part of the initial invitation to the event.
